summary: The customer wants to investigate whether optical measurements can detect composition changes in a hot polymer extrusion process containing an active pharmaceutical ingredient, and requests an initial comparison plan and probe selection guidance.

facts_stated.text: They are developing a hot polymer extrusion process incorporating an API.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: We are developing a hot polymer extrusion process that incorporates an active pharmaceutical ingredient.

facts_stated.text: They want to know if optical measurement can detect composition changes in the melt.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: We want to investigate whether an optical measurement can detect composition changes while the melt is being processed.

facts_stated.text: The process interface is hot and may experience material build-up.
facts_stated.enquiry_quote: the process interface is hot and may be exposed to material build up.
